data.name: BIOFILICA AMBIPAR ENVIRONMENTAL INVESTMENTS S.A.
data.description: Founded in 2008, Biofílica Ambipar Environment's mission is to establish a strong and reliable market for environmental services in Brazil by generating and trading carbon credits from Nature-Based Solutions (NBS). Biophilic Ambipar Environment was acquired on 30-Jul-2021 by Ambipar Participacoes e Empreendimentos. It now operates as the carbon-solutions arm of Ambipar Group, offering REDD+, ARR, ALM, Blue Carbon and biochar credits.
